diagnosis: Concatenated amended annual report reuses toc441273_10 in multiple fund sections. The first global NAME belongs to another fund; the first matching NAME after the SOXX-named HREF is the target Schedule of Investments.
fixed_repair: Require the exact SOXX-named HREF at pinned offset; find the first same-id NAME only after that href. Verify start/end and bounded section SHA, title, September 30 2016, Security/Shares/Value and COMMON STOCKS. Then apply unchanged fixed shares/value/total parser and exact comparison with first version.
availability_boundary: No amendment value may be used before 2017-08-15 acceptance and conservative next-session gate, even if numerically equal to the original.
stop: Any byte offset, section hash, date, table or printed-total mismatch leaves amendment semantics unqualified; no other anchor search or refetch.
